messages:
Zoe (CS): Hey finance — partner DataFjord (acct DFJ-77) flagged invoice INV-2026-07-3342. They say their reserved hours were billed for an extra day due to a timezone edge-case on 2026-07-01 -> 07-02 migration. Can someone check proration?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-07-3342 generated 2026-07-03 09:01 UTC. Lines: RESERVED-DAYPASS 1x (nightly reserved block) 2026-07-01 - 2026-07-31 $9,300.00; Usage $410.20; Promo PARTNER10 -10% applied; Total due $8,691.18.

Marco (BillingOps): Pulling subscription event log. I see the plan change recorded at 2026-07-02 00:05 local (America/Los_Angeles) but our ingest pipeline normalized to UTC and treated it as 2026-07-02 07:05 UTC, so the system billed full day 07-01. Likely an off-by-timezone in event write.

Zoe (CS): The partner says they downgraded effective 2026-07-02 00:00 local and provided the support ticket #SUP-2441. They want the extra day credited and a brief note for procurement.

Marco (BillingOps): Ran proration. Quick calc:
```
Account: DFJ-77
Change date local: 2026-07-02 00:00 PDT (recorded incorrectly as 2026-07-02 07:05 UTC)
Original reserved monthly: $9,300.00 (full month)
Correct prorated reserved should charge for 30 days instead of 31 -> charged amount should be (30/31)*9300 = 9000.00
Delta reserved overcharge = 9300 - 9000 = 300.00
Promo PARTNER10 applied -> promo reduces net overcharge by 10% => corrective credit = 300 * 0.9 = 270.00
Plus small usage duplicate line: system also duplicated a one-off usage credit of 15.20 (erroneous negative line) -> net reconcile = 270.00 + 15.20 = 285.20
Suggested memo: CR-2026-07-411
```
Rounded recommended credit = $285.20.

Elena (Finance): I can approve up to $500 for operational corrections. Approve $285.20 credit and mark reason = timezone ingestion bug. Marco, include SUP-2441 and ENG-telemetry tag in memo.

Marco (BillingOps): Creating credit memo now. Entry snippet:
```
CreditMemo: CR-2026-07-411
Customer: DFJ-77 (DataFjord)
Amount: -285.20 USD
AppliedTo: INV-2026-07-3342
Reason: Prorated reserved overcharge due to event timezone normalization bug (SUP-2441, ENG-telemetry-77)
CreatedBy: Marco (BillingOps)
```
Applied 2026-07-03 15:20 UTC. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: CreditMemo CR-2026-07-411 created and applied to INV-2026-07-3342 on 2026-07-03 15:20 UTC. New balance $8,406. -285.20 adjusted.

Zoe (CS): Thanks Marco & Elena. I'll send DataFjord a short note with CR-2026-07-411 and the support ticket. Offer a one-time discount code DFJ-COURTESY-50 for $50 credit as apology? Approved?

Elena (Finance): One-time $50 courtesy OK to offer but get explicit acceptance from customer before applying. If they accept, create separate memo CR-2026-07-412 and mark "customer-approved".

Marco (BillingOps): Ledger note added and ENG tagged to fix timezone handling (ENG-telemetry-77). Closing unless customer opts into the courtesy credit.
